name: World Cup
author: Kiki
description: Host eight-player live cups with semifinals, finalist scoring, track picks, and switchable racer POV spectating.
changelog: Choose official, community, and locally saved custom tracks directly in the Tracks tab.
Show each connected player's real car skin beside their name using the native thumbnail renderer.
Give the disconnect rule label proper spacing and isolate text-field typing from game controls.
Eight-player cups, finalist scoring, sequential semifinals, and switchable racer POV spectating.
